title: Doctor visit – Dr. Mehta, City Clinic
text: Bad reaction after eating peanut chutney at the office canteen. My throat swelled up, I got red rashes all over my body and I could not breathe properly. Dr. Mehta said it was a severe reaction (anaphylaxis). Never eat peanuts or anything cooked in groundnut oil. Always carry the EpiPen injection in my bag.
